acceptance: Extract one reusable proposal, runner, retrieval, specification, seal and custody implementation while preserving existing command and import behavior through project adapters.

Standalone execution requires explicit project, trusted policy, catalog, corpus, model capabilities, budget and state configuration. Missing or ambiguous configuration fails closed, and retrieved corpus content remains untrusted evidence.

Real local Chroma indexing and search operate on synthetic public fixtures without skips, preserve source, chunk and configuration identities, reject stale evidence and publish index state consistently.

Proposal results and generated specifications preserve the current oracle-spec/1 format, complete acceptance-to-test bindings and exact input identities. Malformed, incomplete and uncertain executions retain their actual outcomes without automatic replay or paid fallback. Recovery of completed model output requires matching input, configuration, corpus, core, runtime and result identities; stale or tampered recovery fails closed. Materialization requires an explicit valid upstream origin distinct from tool-source identity, includes it in operation and recovery bindings, and never substitutes source_commit. An exact project Git root supplies its own HEAD, tree and reachable existing origin/main; parent repositories are excluded, and missing upstream fails before model execution.

Export reads immutable committed inputs through a complete closed mapping, rejects unsafe or unlisted members and produces independently verifiable artifact bytes with license, attribution and provenance. The exact public inventory includes its explicitly mapped CI workflow. Source provenance distinguishes the canonical commit identity from independently established upstream publication. The sole added generation input is the existing sealed candidate specification: require a regular immutable blob, valid existing family seal, lowercase 40-hex upstream commit, commit existence and ancestry to the candidate. Export only origin_main as the additional generated manifest key; preserve the 31-member inventory and exclude the raw specification, policy and approval evidence.

A fresh exported installation runs independently of private knowledge, sibling checkouts and undeclared host configuration. Private material, credentials, operational state and product packages remain outside the artifact. Its public CI executes all four public test modules and the real labelled retrieval benchmark without model or provider calls or credentials.

A separate deterministic verification profile binds complete committed source, selected tests, artifact bytes, runtime, dependencies and retained outputs. Existing profiles and publication restrictions remain enforced, with no completed-source model fallback. Full native VERIFIED requires every selected module. Public CI executes a separately typed CI_ONLY projection omitting exactly the native live-proposal module, makes no provider calls and receives no provider credentials. Publication rejects CI_ONLY as a substitute for a current full native receipt and rejects missing, stale or tampered native evidence. Only a separately declared bounded setup stage in the existing CI job or explicitly mapped public workflow may provision the pinned Python runtime, binary-only hash-locked dependencies and hash-verified public embedding archive. Archive admission enforces download and extracted-size limits and rejects unsafe paths, links, duplicate entries and unsupported member types. Optional caching contains only verified public setup inputs and revalidates restored bytes. Missing, incompatible or unverified setup fails closed; validation runtime never installs or downloads missing inputs. Receipts bind runtime, dependency-lock and embedding identities. Explicit artifact-only validation binds the genuine sealed feature base, executes the complete native selected commands and standalone export checks, and records COMPONENT_ARTIFACT_VERIFIED with source_publication=false. Current origin observation remains separate metadata. Every source push and promotion path refuses artifact-only receipts, including when origin later matches their base; existing whole-range source-publication guards remain enforced. Public upload requires current full native component proof, followed by independent public CI and exact-commit artifact readback. The native witness requires exact equality between the immutable candidate specification upstream, generated manifest upstream, completed provenance upstream and materialized specification stamp, and rejects absent, malformed or mismatched values.

A bounded normal-plan model-adapter demonstration consumes only public example inputs and records a truthful conceptual proposal outcome with exact configuration and model evidence. Its upstream provenance matches the immutable exported manifest and candidate specification while tool-source identity remains separately bound.
Benchmark output identifies execution mode, independently authored labels, corpus, embedding, model and source identities and measured results without unsupported comparative claims.
